context_requirements: Expression of ACE (or ACE2) in the assayed cell line
Presence of an active local renin-angiotensin system or angiotensin II signaling
Cellular context in which ACE inhibition changes angiotensin II/AT1R signaling enough to alter transcription
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar ACE inhibitor treatment in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of angiotensin II/AT1R or bradykinin signaling transcriptional signatures after treatment
Consistent ACE inhibitor class-specific gene expression changes across multiple cell lines
